purpose: Pinned comparison-oracle and supporting-source references for Republic of Armenia Axiom coverage. Armenia has no incumbent tax-benefit engine; references are published fiscal-incidence studies used as validation bands, not executable oracles.

oracles.name: CEQ Working Paper 43: Fiscal Incidence in Armenia (Younger & Khachatryan, 2017)
oracles.role: Fiscal-incidence bands from ILCS 2011 under the CEQ methodology; also published as a chapter in Inchauste & Lustig (eds.), The Distributional Impact of Taxes and Transfers (World Bank, 2017).

oracles.name: World Bank: Assessing the Distributional Impacts of PIT Reform in Armenia (2019)
oracles.role: CEQ-model microsimulation on ILCS 2014 aged to 2018; reference bands for the 2020 flat-tax transition (e.g., disposable-income Gini path under the reform).

oracles.name: World Bank: From Policy to Impact — Fiscal Incidence Analysis in Armenia (2025)
oracles.role: Most recent fiscal-incidence bands; closest vintage to the populace-am 2024 build year.

notes: Exact document URLs, retrieval dates, and shas are recorded when each study is pinned as a fixture. PolicyEngine-style engines are absent by design: no policyengine-am exists and none should be created.
